title: AutoMountBKP: an automatic backup when the backup disk is plugged in
description: Step-by-step notes for a Linux office server: an fstab entry, a udev rule, an rsync backup script and a systemd unit, so a labelled USB backup disk is mounted, receives a full backup of the shared folders and the Samba Active Directory backup, is synced, unmounted and powered off, with beeps and log lines at each stage.
